Web Development Manager
We are currently hiring a Web Development Manager to lead our web development team and oversee the delivery of high-quality websites and digital solutions in line with business requirements, brand guidelines, and industry standards.
Responsibilities
Reviewing layouts and designs for web development projects to ensure they meet brand requirements, usability standards, and industry best practices.
Planning, managing, and monitoring web development projects to ensure they are delivered within agreed budgets and timelines.
Leading, mentoring, coaching, and evaluating the performance of the web development team.
Delegating responsibilities and ensuring effective collaboration between front-end, back-end, UI/UX, graphic design, and other relevant teams.
Understanding programming languages and web technologies to review code, monitor development activities, and ensure coding standards are maintained.
Selecting appropriate technologies, platforms, frameworks, and tools based on project requirements.
Ensuring web development standards, security requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements are followed.
Overseeing website deployment, integrations, hosting, domain, SSL, backup, security, and ongoing maintenance activities.
Analysing web traffic and user behaviour data to identify trends, usage patterns, and opportunities for improving website performance and user experience.
Improving website design, functionality, responsiveness, speed, accessibility, and overall performance.
Developing and maintaining backup and recovery plans to minimise the impact of website downtime or technical issues.
Coordinating with the Marketing and Content teams to develop and publish website content aligned with business and marketing objectives.
Working closely with the SEO and Digital Marketing teams to improve organic search rankings, implement SEO strategies, and support search engine marketing activities.
Supporting and coordinating social media management, including planning social media content, maintaining content calendars, coordinating creative assets, publishing and scheduling posts, and ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.
Monitoring social media engagement, reach, traffic, and other relevant performance indicators and using insights to improve digital marketing strategies.
Coordinating website and social media campaigns with marketing initiatives, promotions, product launches, and business objectives.
Ensuring consistency of brand messaging and visual identity across websites, social media platforms, and other digital channels.
Using appropriate testing and quality assurance techniques before, during, and after projects to ensure website quality and reliability.
Maintaining proper technical and project documentation for web development platforms, applications, integrations, and related systems.
Advocating for the requirements of the website production and digital marketing teams and supporting the recruitment of suitable team members, including developers, designers, content creators, and digital marketing resources.
Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience in leading and managing web development teams.
Extensive experience in developing, deploying, integrating, and maintaining web solutions.
Strong understanding of web technologies, CMS platforms, databases, APIs, hosting, security, SEO, and website performance optimisation.
Experience working with digital marketing, SEO, content management, and social media platforms will be an added advantage.
Strong project management and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
A strong understanding of UI/UX, responsive web design, and digital user experience.
Ability to mentor, coach, and develop team members.
A creative, analytical, and results-oriented approach to web and digital solutions.
The selected candidate is assured of an attractive remuneration package. Send your detailed resume to
careers@dtech.lk
along with contact details of two non-related referees within days of this advertisement.
